title: Torsion Wave Dispersion Relation
plaintext:
TORSION WAVE DISPERSION
=======================
Wave equation: □δT + m²_eff·δT + 3λT_vev·(δT)² = J_spin

Dispersion: ω² = k² + m²_eff   (massive Klein-Gordon type)

Parameters:
  μ² = 1.0048e-2 eV²
  λ_q = 0.000985
  m_eff = 2.3508e-1 eV
  T_vev = 2.2583e+0 m⁻²
  ω = 0.1005 s⁻¹
  k = 0.0100 m⁻¹
  v_group = 0.099735 c   (subluminal ✓)
  Amplitude = 1.383e-1
  J_spin = -2.382e-2
